I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

The source is Dana's Aug 20, 2025 post in #north-team, which Marcus can see. In it she said Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again on the morning shift: the same trailer showed up as two rows after a kiosk check-in and a manual add by dispatch. I also mentioned that Dana owns the account now, so she's the internal point person.

Thea's job title and Dana's ownership come from the brain's Quarrendon account page, not that post. A contact is an operational fact Marcus can have as a North team member. No money figures were involved.
